tools.name: check_doctor_availability
tools.description: Check available appointment slots for doctors in the connected DigitalBot clinic. Always use this before offering a time.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Create a confirmed appointment in DigitalBot after availability has been checked and the caller has confirmed.

tools.name: lookup_troubleshooting
tools.description: Call this tool whenever a customer reports a product problem. First identify the product, then pass the complete customer problem. Use only the returned troubleshooting steps. If matched is true and hasVideo is true, immediately call send_troubleshooting_video using the exact returned product and entryId.

tools.name: send_troubleshooting_video
tools.description: Call this tool only after lookup_troubleshooting returns matched true and hasVideo true. Pass the exact product and entryId returned by lookup_troubleshooting.IF ANYONE  TELL ISSUE IF THERE IS TROUBLESHOOTING VIDEO THAN SEND ISSUE LINK.

tools.name: send_customer_link
tools.description: Call this tool whenever the customer requests an approved Akiara link. Use callerNumber as customerPhone. Select the correct linkType based on the customer’s request. Confirm delivery only when the response returns success true and sent true.

tools.name: check_doctor_availability
tools.description: Check available appointment slots for doctors in the connected DigitalBot clinic. Always use this before offering a time.

parameters.name: assignedPhoneNumber
parameters.description: {{ToPhone}}

parameters.name: doctorId
parameters.description: Doctor ID returned by a previous availability check, when known.

parameters.name: doctorName
parameters.description: Doctor name when the ID is not known.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: specialization
parameters.description: Doctor specialization, when the caller asks for one.

messages: Let me check the doctor's availability.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Create a confirmed appointment in DigitalBot after availability has been checked and the caller has confirmed.

parameters.name: assignedPhoneNumber
parameters.description: {{ToPhone}}

parameters.name: doctorId
parameters.description: Doctor ID returned by check_doctor_availability, when known.

parameters.name: doctorName
parameters.description: Doctor name when the ID is not known.

parameters.name: patientName
parameters.description: Patient's full name.

parameters.name: patientPhone
parameters.description: {{FromPhone}}

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: An available appointment time returned by check_doctor_availability.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: Reason for the appointment.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Patient location or address, when needed.

parameters.name: age
parameters.description: Patient age in years, when known.

messages: I am booking that appointment now.
